name: climarisk-video
description: Animated demo video for ClimaRisk Tunisie (Remotion). Figures come from ../outputs/kpis.json.

scripts.build: npm run props && npm run render
scripts.capture: node scripts/record_dashboard.js && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i public/capture/dashboard.webm -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -r 30 -crf 20 public/capture/dashboard.mp4
